_: Named locks. Each key is a lock with its own passphrase, read from WIKI_LOCK_PASSPHRASE_<NAME> (or the WIKI_LOCK_PASSPHRASES JSON bundle); its pages are slugs as they appear after /brain/, or a prefix ending in * for a whole branch. Pages under different locks share no key. Seal with `npm run wiki:lock`. See scripts/wiki-locks.mjs and the README.
